_doc: Network budget for the homepage at 390x844 (phone). Bytes are WIRE bytes: Chrome's encodedDataLength per request (compressed, as received over the network; a cache hit or 304 counts only its headers). 'initial' = from navigation to load + 4 s of idle; 'fullScroll' = after scrolling the whole page. 'ceilings' fail the test (set just above the measured state of 1 Oct 2026, so regressions fail CI); 'targets' are the spec's goals, reported, not enforced yet. Media (gallery clips) is reported separately: it only downloads when the gallery is on screen and a clip is in focus.
_forbiddenDoc: Assets that must never load before the visitor scrolls. The hero's own ring maps (/assets/globe/rings-map-*) are hero assets, and the gallery's sheets load by distance (on a phone the gallery starts within 2.5 screens), so neither is listed. three.js is caught by the initialScript ceiling (chunk names are hashed).
